decision.what: The polling check keys a Bash call by its FULL command text, never the 60-char target string target_of() derives server-side.
decision.why: An early version grouped Bash calls by the truncated target, which produced dozens of false polling flags on 361c4d18's own real data (different commands that just happened to start with the same 'cd some/long/path && ...' prefix looked identical). Re-grouping by input.command (kept raw on every call entry) fixed it to zero false positives; verified by re-running against the same real transcript before and after.

verdict.why: All 5 build steps done, both prove-it checks from the brief satisfied against real data (not a hand-built fixture), headless UI check clean at 1920, docs updated. Open, named gaps: trace.json stays manual (not Stop-hook-wired, documented as a deliberate limitation); the Bash-write heuristic for polling/run-flags is a regex over command text, not a certainty (documented as a tunable); the chart's hover is a native <title> tooltip per tick, not a synced crosshair (documented as the cheapest version that actually satisfies the dataviz hover rule).
